result.reason: The clause adds the required annual frequency cap, business-hours restriction, independent confidential auditor, no systems access, and 5% cost-shifting threshold. However, requiring the audit to be permitted “within 30 days” after a written request does not provide 30 days’ advance written notice—and may allow an immediate audit—so it meets neither the preferred nor fallback notice period. Cost shifting also remains tied to any “discrepancy,” rather than specifically an underpayment exceeding 5%. The revisions are otherwise limited and preserve the original commercial intent, but the notice drafting prevents playbook compliance.
